label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to build a small, gracious weekly rhythm — a trellis, not a law — under five simple headings.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If a rule like this ever becomes rigid — if missing an item causes disproportionate distress, or items must be done in a fixed order to feel safe — stop and speak with a qualified professional. Never change medication because of anything here.

label: Key Scripture
h: "And rising very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed."

label: Meet Jonathan
h: "They work. I just wait until I need them."

label: A Trellis, Not a Law
h: A “rule of life” is not a legal code. It is a trellis: a simple structure that helps something living grow toward the light.
body: You will not build a commitment in every area. Establish one small central practice, then one or two supporting ones where they fit.

label: Five Areas to Choose From, Not All at Once
body:
CentrePrayer and communion with God. Not necessarily long or early — regular, at a time, place or cue the week protects.
FormationScripture, read steadily and unhurried, and safe, accessible Christian community.
EmbodimentSleep, movement and rest — supporting the body, not treating a disorder.
BoundariesWork and digital life. A boundary you write for your own week, one you can actually keep.

And Support: the people and professionals you can actually call on.

label: A Few Honest Limits
body:
Habits can support sleep. They do not guarantee it, and they are not a treatment for insomnia.

Choose movement that is medically appropriate — ask your doctor if you are unsure.

Do not return to an unsafe congregation merely to satisfy a weekly rule.

label: A Common Belief
h: "If I miss a day, the whole rule has failed, and so have I."
body: A trellis that has started to strangle the plant is not doing its work. The rule serves you; you do not serve the rule.

label: The Practice · Your One-Page Rule
body:
The honest weekWrite what your week actually contains under the five areas, not what you intend.
One line eachOne practice toward God, one for the body, one boundary, one form of support.
Grace clause and a dateWhat you will do when you miss it, and when — about a month out — you will review the whole page.

label: Do This Now
h: Write one honest sentence about this week. Then write one small line for the area that has slipped the most.
body:
The full one-page rule worksheet is under this lesson.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: When you miss a practice, return without a reckoning. The trellis may fall. God's faithfulness does not.

label: Prayer
body:
Lord, build in me a small and gracious rhythm
for the life I actually have.

When I miss it, let me return without a reckoning.

The trellis may fall. Your faithfulness does not.

Amen.
